Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 85. Category: form. Super Saiyan Grades.

The Super Saiyan’s muscle mass increases drastically,
slowing them slightly but increasing their raw power.
Increase your Power by 1
You deal an additional 1d4 to all damage
Decrease your Movement Speed by 10 ft.
You gain +1 Bulk
At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Stamina
